per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall run on any OS where the Java runtime can be installed, including Linux, Windows, and Solaris.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be deployable on existing web or application servers such as Tomcat or JBoss.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support multiple database management systems, including Postgres, Oracle, and SQL Server.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to small actions within 5 seconds and heavier tasks within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support at least 1,000 concurrent requests today and scale to support 2,000 concurrent requests in the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve 99.99% uptime, excluding server-level failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall authenticate users using corporate identity providers such as LDAP or SAML.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall sanitize inputs and validate everything server-side to prevent SQL injection and data corruption.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall follow standard design patterns and best practices to ensure maintainability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be designed using Design Patterns and coding best practices. 90% of maintenance software developers are able to integrate new functionality into the product with 2 working days.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support localization and be brandable to apply different offices' company look and feel.
The system shall be operable in clustered setups for high availability and support rolling upgrades.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be stateless where feasible to facilitate backups and instance replacement.
The system shall not send personally identifiable information (PII) or full user content in external reports.
